title: Great design!
text: Great design!. I love this pan!! Because its square on the inside, I can now make 2 grilled cheese sandwiches at the same time. They fit very nice . Wish I had this pan much sooner. Heats up well and washes up nicely.

product_metadata.title: Not a Square Pan SP-1020 8 Inch Classic Nonstick Square Fry Pan, Gray
features: ⭐ The Only Square Bottom and Round Top Fry Pan in the market. The square bottom allows 20% more square cooking surface while the round top ensures it fits all lids and splatters.

⭐ Ultra non-stick coating scratch resistant: The ultra-non-stick and scratch-resistant enhances both durability and cooking efficiency. Everything really slips off the non-stick surface for maximum cooking. For a healthy diet, use low to medium heat with minimal oil or butter.
⭐ Made With professional material: Aluminium high stability and anti-rust performance including gas, electricity, electric ring, halogen, glass stove, and more.

⭐ Wide applications & Non-toxic - The 8-inch non-stick fry pan provides more space for non-stick cooking and is perfect for large cooking projects. You can make traditional curry, chicken, vegetables, delicious pancakes, cheese casserole. They also bring stylish wooden handles. nontoxic cookware coating that is PFOA and PTFE free for healthy cooking

⭐ Easy to Clean & FAST, EVEN HEATING - Reduced oil consumption and a healthy lifestyle. Saving time and water, measuring ease, and quick cleaning. Dishwasher safe yet recommended for hand washing.
